Problem and target users

The problem

  • A loan decision depends on applications, payments, bureau data and policy rules held in different systems.
  • Regulators and applicants need the reasons.
  • An LLM explanation can state a value or a reason that the data does not support.
  • Even the reason code stored on the decision record can be wrong.

Who it is for

  • Credit analysts and reviewers
  • Model-risk and compliance teams
  • Applicants, through an illustrative reasons letter
  • No time-saved or accuracy figures are claimed; all data is synthetic.
SYNTHETIC data. Harbor Credit is a fictional lender.Why-Ledger · 2

The solution: a Why-Card in which every claim is checked

  • Drivers ranked from scorecard points in the data, not by the model
  • Only VERIFIED claims reach the card; unsupported drafts go to a rejected panel
  • Counterfactual for declines: the smallest change that flips the decision
  • Evidence drawer: SQL, rows and SHA-256 for every claim
  • Illustrative applicant letter of ranked principal reasons (not legal advice)
SYNTHETIC data. Harbor Credit is a fictional lender.Why-Ledger · 3

It caught the lender's own wrong reason

Loan LN-1301

  • The decision record says INCOME_BELOW_THRESHOLD. Declared income is 110,000, above the 40,000 policy threshold, so rule R01 is not triggered.
  • The check re-runs SQL on Zetaris and shows record and data side by side. It states what the record says; it does not assign blame.
  • Data-supported drivers: bureau score 56.1 %, credit enquiries 35.7 %. Counterfactual: bureau score 580 flips the decline to approve.
  • Planted mismatches flagged: 1 of 1. False flags on the other 3 loans: 0.
SYNTHETIC data. Harbor Credit is a fictional lender.Why-Ledger · 4

Agent workflow and architecture

Questione.g. why was LN-1301 declined?
›
Scout IntentMeterless: sense, guard, route
›
Evidenceread-only SQL on Zetaris
›
Ledgerrows + SHA-256, append-only
›
DraftNemotron via Nightshift writes claims that cite queries
›
Verifierno LLM: re-runs the SQL, compares hash, value, column and loan scope
›
Why-Cardverified claims, drivers, counterfactual, reason check, letter
  • Zetaris is the only data path; the model sees data only through logged queries.
  • Planned mode: code chooses the evidence queries and one Nemotron call drafts the claims. Rejected claims are shown, never hidden.
  • Recorded-reason check (deterministic): compares the reason code on the record with the policy rule and the data.
SYNTHETIC data. Harbor Credit is a fictional lender.Why-Ledger · 5

Technical stack and sponsor technology

ZetarisSole data path. Live JDBC to Zetaris 2.4.3.1 (local Docker) over SYNTHETIC tables; agent queries and verifier re-runs are read-only SQL. It is also the verifier's oracle for what the model cited.
Meterless Scout IntentEvery question is sensed, guarded and routed before any model runs; injected prompts are refused (tested on a port of the upstream adversarial set).
Meterless NightshiftPrimary LLM provider: an OpenAI-compatible runtime on the Windows host, reached from WSL. All four recorded runs show provider meterless-nightshift.
NVIDIA Nemotronnvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b via Nightshift drafts the claims (1 call per loan).
CursorAll production code (src/, scripts/, UI, tests) written by cursor-agent; every task logged in docs/CURSOR-LOG.md.
What is uniqueThe model's own cited SQL is re-executed on Zetaris and each stated value is tied to its named column; the record's reason code is checked against the data too.

Verifier stress test and honest limits

  • 14 planted cases on live Zetaris: 4 VERIFIED, 10 UNSUPPORTED
  • Verdict matched 14/14; intended failure reason matched 14/14 (reported separately)
  • Honest failure: an earlier LN-1230 attempt crashed on a non-existent column; the verifier now rejects such claims
  • Limits: synthetic data, 4 loans, one Nemotron model works on this account, one run per loan, not compliance advice
SYNTHETIC data. Harbor Credit is a fictional lender.Why-Ledger · 9

Future enhancements

  • Model-proposed SQL loop mode with a hardened verifier (the one live loop run was weak: eval/live-nemotron-smoke.md)
  • Federation across more Zetaris sources inside one verified query
  • Richer policy engine and more reason-code checks beyond income
  • Meterless H-MEM precedent memory: reuse verified explanations across similar cases
  • Multiple runs per loan for latency and agreement ranges
  • Real-data governance review before any production use
